comment: What each Halo: Reach medal is for, in Project Noble's own words, by MCC's medal key (the site's art/medals.json). tools/service_record.py puts it on each medal of last_carnage.txt; the game's carnage report shows it on a medal hovered or focused (Nov 23, the owner). A medal not listed shows its name only. Checked against Halopedia's list where unsure; Second Wind left out (not confirmed).

what.medal_double_kill: Kill 2 enemies within 4 seconds of each other.
what.medal_triple_of_each_kill: Kill 3 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_overkill: Kill 4 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killtacular: Kill 5 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killtrocity: Kill 6 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killimanjaro: Kill 7 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killtastrophe: Kill 8 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killpocalypse: Kill 9 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_killionaire: Kill 10 enemies, each within 4 seconds of the last.
what.medal_shotgun_shotgun_spree: Kill 5 enemies with a shotgun without dying.
what.medal_open_season: Kill 10 enemies with a shotgun without dying.
what.medal_buck_wild: Kill 15 enemies with a shotgun without dying.
what.medal_sniper_rifle_w_spree: Kill 5 enemies with a sniper rifle without dying.
what.medal_sharpshooter_rifle_w_sharpshooter: Kill 10 enemies with a sniper rifle without dying.
what.medal_be_the_bullet: Kill 15 enemies with a sniper rifle without dying.
what.medal_sword_sword_w_spree: Kill 5 enemies with the energy sword without dying.
what.medal_slice_sword_w_dice: Kill 10 enemies with the energy sword without dying.
what.medal_cutting_crew: Kill 15 enemies with the energy sword without dying.
what.medal_splatter_row_wit_spree: Run over 5 enemies with a vehicle without dying.
what.medal_vehicle_row_wit_manslaughter: Run over 10 enemies with a vehicle without dying.
what.medal_sunday_driver: Run over 15 enemies with a vehicle without dying.
what.medal_hammer_spree: Kill 5 enemies with the gravity hammer without dying.
what.medal_dream_crusher: Kill 10 enemies with the gravity hammer without dying.
what.medal_wrecking_crew: Kill 15 enemies with the gravity hammer without dying.
what.medal_laser_spree: Kill 5 enemies with the Spartan Laser without dying.
what.medal_red_menace: Kill 10 enemies with the Spartan Laser without dying.
what.medal_sunburst: Kill 15 enemies with the Spartan Laser without dying.
what.medal_stick_spree: Kill 5 enemies with stuck plasma grenades without dying.
what.medal_sticky_fingers: Kill 10 enemies with stuck plasma grenades without dying.
what.medal_corrected: Kill 15 enemies with stuck plasma grenades without dying.
what.medal_headshot: Kill an enemy with a shot to the head.
what.medal_assist: Help a teammate kill an enemy.
what.medal_melee_kill: Kill an enemy with a melee attack.
what.medal_beat_down: Kill an enemy with a melee attack from behind.
what.medal_assassination: Kill an enemy with an assassination from behind.
what.medal_grenade_stick: Kill an enemy by sticking them with a plasma grenade.
what.medal_splatter_with_a__splatter: Kill an enemy by running them over with a vehicle.
what.medal_sniper_kill: Kill an enemy with a sniper rifle.
what.medal_laser_kill: Kill an enemy with the Spartan Laser.
what.medal_supercombine_using_a_supercombine: Kill an enemy with a Needler supercombine: enough needles to make them explode.
what.medal_revenge: Kill the enemy who last killed you.
what.medal_avenger: Kill an enemy who just killed a teammate.
what.medal_reload_this: Kill an enemy while they reload.
what.medal_close_call: Kill an enemy while your shields are down and you are close to death.
what.medal_first_strike: Get the first kill of the match.
what.medal_protector: Save a teammate by killing the enemy attacking them.
what.medal_showstopper_the_ass_showstopper: Kill an enemy while they are performing an assassination.
what.medal_headcase: Kill a sprinting enemy with a headshot.
what.medal_firebird: Kill an enemy while you are flying with a jetpack.
what.medal_kill_jetpack: Kill an enemy who is flying with a jetpack.
what.medal_kill_from_the_grave: Kill an enemy after you have died, with a grenade or shot already on its way.
what.medal_hijack: Take a ground vehicle by throwing its enemy driver out.
what.medal_skyjack: Take an aircraft by throwing its enemy pilot out.
what.medal_wheelman_kill_an_wheelman: Drive a vehicle while your passenger or gunner kills an enemy.
what.medal_extermination: Wipe out the whole enemy team, with at least an Overkill.
what.medal_perfection: Win a Slayer game with at least 15 kills and no deaths.
what.medal_flag_captured: Bring the enemy flag back to your base to score.
what.medal_flag_carrier_kill: Kill the enemy carrying a flag.
what.medal_flag_kill: Kill an enemy with the flag as a melee weapon.
what.medal_bomb_planted: Arm the bomb at the enemy's base.
what.medal_bomb_carrier_kill: Kill the enemy carrying the bomb.
what.medal_ball_carrier_kill: Kill the enemy holding the Oddball.
what.medal_ball_kill: Kill an enemy with the Oddball as a melee weapon.
what.medal_juggernaut_spree: Kill 5 enemies as the Juggernaut without dying.
what.medal_zombie_killing_spree: As a survivor, kill 5 zombies without dying.
what.medal_last_man_standing: Be the last survivor left in Infection.
